title: The Rabid Wolverine
author: Brady V.
desc:
To allow for room to improve your physique in a way to help you stand out more wherever you go and make you generally stronger 
Ideally no more than 10 weeks no less than 6
This is supposed to emphasize progressive overload and intensity,ideally mix in some cardio too,ideally you’re someone trying to gain but it works regardless

ex.note: Minimal rest
First set should be crazy strict second should be blood and guts
90 seconds rest between sets percentage is just a gauge go by feel
This should be done seated and incredibly strict,first working set is a feeler to make sure you engage the delts as needed but shouldn’t be easy,the other 3 should be torturous
Just try to fill the rear delts with blood flow pump them up and focus on perfect technique
Focus on moving some heavy iron here minimal rest
Focus on squeezing hard at the top for 2-3 seconds and use straps if need be
45 seconds rest focus on slow eccentric and deep stretch
2 minutes rest between sets this should be high effort and the percentage rule is the same as bench on day 1
Same rule as rear delts from day 1
Plank till failure try to beat your time week to week
Focus on going full rom every rep last set should be total failure and squeeze hard at the top of ever rep
Choose an attachment and keep it for 3-4 weeks,do one set semi explosive and the rest incredibly strict
Squeeze hard at the top and take a minute rest between sets
One minute rest between this should be hard
Minimal rest focus on good rom but try to bias the tricep same goes for the weighted set
Perfect form is the goal,1 minute rest
Longer rest don’t be sloppy but weight is a factor here
Spend the first 4 doing technical reps and the last one go for broke take a minute of rest
Minimal rest be strict but use the first to hoist big weights and the last set to dial in technique and grind out reps
90 seconds rest take this to failure deep stretch go for big weights
a minute rest feel stretch short pause at bottom squeeze a little toward top but don’t touch dumbbells together
45 seconds rest super strict good stretch good squeeze and aim for top end of all rep ranges if possible
3 minutes of strict pushups to failure
